overview.text: Coca-Cola HBC completed its $2.6 billion acquisition of a 75% stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa, following approval from Tanzania's Fair Competition Commission.
The Central Bank of Nigeria appointed Murtala Mohammed as acting managing director and CEO of Keystone Bank, replacing Hassan Imam.
The CBN said depositors' funds at Keystone Bank are safe, The Guardian reported.
Oando announced final terms of a N203.8 billion rights issue.

cards.headline: Reps demand urgent repairs of failed East-West Road culverts
cards.what_happened: The House of Representatives has urged the Federal Ministry of Works to direct Rock Result Nigeria Limited to return to site and rehabilitate or reconstruct failed box culverts on the East-West Road, particularly at Iheke in Ahoada East Local Government Area of Rivers State. The House also called for an independent engineering assessment and technical supervision of the remedial works.
key_facts: The House urged the Federal Ministry of Works to direct Rock Result Nigeria Limited to rehabilitate or reconstruct failed box culverts.
The failed culverts are located at Iheke in Ahoada East Local Government Area of Rivers State.
The House adopted the motion moved by Oboku Oforji at plenary on Wednesday.
analysis: Why it matters: The motion raises questions about the quality and supervision of publicly funded road works, and calls for independent assessment of contractor performance. It also highlights re-award of the continuation contract to Setraco Nigeria Limited amid unfinished dualisation.

cards.headline: Coca-Cola HBC completes $2.6 billion acquisition of African bottler CCBA
cards.what_happened: Coca-Cola HBC has completed its $2.6 billion acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Africa (CCBA), following regulatory approval from Tanzania's Fair Competition Commission. The deal gives Coca-Cola HBC control of a bottling business operating in 14 African countries and makes it the world's second-largest Coca-Cola bottler by volume.
key_facts: Coca-Cola HBC acquired a 75% stake in CCBA from The Coca-Cola Company and Gutsche Family Investments for $2.6 billion.
Coca-Cola HBC issued 21,027,676 new ordinary shares to Gutsche Family Investments, representing 5.45% of its enlarged share capital.
CCBA recorded 2025 revenue of $3.69 billion, up 1.6% from $3.63 billion in 2024.
Coca-Cola HBC has reaffirmed plans to invest up to $1 billion in Nigeria over five years.
analysis: Why it matters: The acquisition expands a major multinational bottler's operations across Africa, including Nigeria, and its planned Nigerian investment affects manufacturing capacity and employment in the country.

cards.headline: Coronation Insurance: understanding the ₦2.88 scheme of arrangement and the road ahead
cards.what_happened: Coronation Insurance Plc's Managing Director/CEO, Olamide Olajolo, explained the company's Scheme of Arrangement, which sets a revised consideration of ₦2.88 per share for eligible minority shareholders. The Federal High Court sanctioned the Scheme on 10 November 2026 after the SEC lifted an administrative suspension, and implementation steps including settlement and delisting remain outstanding.
key_facts: Revised Scheme Consideration is ₦2.88 per share, up from ₦0.78 approved by shareholders in December 2023.
SEC approval was received on 22 October 2026, and the Federal High Court sanctioned the Scheme on 10 November 2026.
Core Shareholders have deposited the funds for payment of the Scheme Consideration into an escrow account.
analysis: Why it matters: The transaction transfers minority shares to Core Shareholders and leads to delisting from the Nigerian Exchange, so ownership of a listed insurer is changing. The article notes that an independent fairness assessment question was not directly answered, leaving the basis of the final price for minority holders…
cards.ownership_caveat: Ownership details as reported by Nairametrics; not verified with CAC records.

cards.headline: CBN appoints acting managing director for Keystone Bank
cards.byline: Premium Times · Fri 27 Nov, 09:52 Lagos · latest of 2 reports from 2 outlets
cards.what_happened: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) has appointed an acting managing director for Keystone Bank.
key_facts: Murtala Mohammed appointed Acting Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Keystone Bank Limited. (Nairametrics)
Statement issued by CBN Director of Corporate Communications and Investor Relations Michael Akuka. (Nairametrics)
timeline: Thu 26 Nov, 22:03 · Nairametrics: “BREAKING: CBN appoints Murtala Mohammed as acting CEO of Keystone Bank”
Fri 27 Nov, 09:52 · Premium Times: “CBN appoints acting managing director for Keystone Bank” (lead report)
analysis: Why it matters: A regulator installing an acting chief executive at a commercial bank signals leadership change at a financial institution under supervisory oversight, which bears on governance and public confidence in the sector.

cards.headline: CBN replaces Keystone Bank CEO, says depositors’ funds are safe
cards.what_happened: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) replaced the Chief Executive Officer of Keystone Bank and assured depositors that their funds are safe.
key_facts: The CBN replaced the Keystone Bank CEO.
The CBN said depositors' funds are safe.
analysis: Why it matters: A regulator-driven change in the chief executive of a commercial bank bears on depositor confidence and on the stability of the banking sector.
